id: title:Gilbert09:recover account property staging from a vacuumed delta snapshot

review.posthog_relevance: Adds recovery handling for AWS S3 NoSuchKey errors during warehouse staging, preventing warehouse ingestion failures when staged objects are missing.
review.reason: The change introduces a helper to detect AWS S3 NoSuchKey errors and a recovery path that re-stages from a committed snapshot instead of failing. This represents a substantive, bounded reliability improvement for warehouse ingestion workflows. P1.F1.H3 is a minor cleanup. No adoption or incident avoidance is inferred.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the presence of recovery logic, but the actual benefit depends on unverified production incidents or adoption, which are not demonstrated in the code.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No tier assignment performed.
